summary: Frontend-only tests for Lithuanian supplement planner new features: Clear All button, scientific reference links per standard supplement, custom supplement autocomplete (fuzzy + exact match), and custom add flow. All 5 targeted new-feature checks PASS. No console errors observed.
passed: Clear All button: enabled with defaults (d3k2, omega3, magnis-glicinatas) selected; after adding a custom item + kreatinas and clicking clear-all-button, all checkboxes unchecked, custom list emptied, schedule empty, button becomes disabled, toast 'Visos varnelės nuimtos' shown.

Ref link - kreatinas: Ticking supplement-checkbox-kreatinas reveals supplement-ref-link-kreatinas with href=https://doi.org/10.1186/s12970-017-0173-z and target=_blank. Clicking link does NOT uncheck the checkbox (stopPropagation works). Unticking removes the link.
Autocomplete fuzzy match: Typing 'selen' shows custom-supplement-suggestions dropdown with custom-suggestion-Selenas. Clicking fills name='Selenas' and dose='100–200 mcg' (en-dash).
Autocomplete exact typing: Typing 'Berberinas' auto-fills dose '500 mg (2–3 k./d.)' and time block.
Custom add: After picking suggestion, clicking custom-supplement-add-button adds 'Berberinas · 500 mg (2–3 k./d.)' to schedule-timeblock-pietus and shows success toast.
critical_code_review_comments: PlannerPage.jsx is 620 lines - approaching the 700-line threshold; consider extracting Supplements section, Custom add block, and Schedule into separate components for maintainability.
handleCustomName does not reset dose/block when the user clears the input or types a non-matching string after an exact match - previously auto-filled values persist. Minor UX nit.
The URL state restore issue flagged in iteration_1.json was NOT retested in this run; main agent should confirm whether it was addressed.
test_credentials: N/A - client-side only app, no auth
context_for_next_testing_agent: iteration_3 covered new features: clear-all-button, supplement-ref-link-[id], custom autocomplete, and custom add. Regression items (profile dose updates, child-blocked, sensitivity switch, interaction warnings, copy-link URL restore, PDF/PNG export) were NOT re-run here since iteration_1 already covered them (only URL restore flagged medium). Default selected supplements: d3k2, omega3, magnis-glicinatas. Dose string uses en-dash '–' not hyphen.
